understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto the goal tile or tiles simultaneously; completing a level advances the game, and winning all levels completes the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel cell increments using directional actions, while walls or other objects can block movement and pushable blocks may shift when adjacent. Multiple selectable pieces can be switched with CLICK using their pixel coordinates; clicking a piece changes the currently controlled piece, but selection alone does not place it on a goal.
